gallery.mainTitle: Relive Every Story in Your Life
gallery.mainSubtitle: From graduations and weddings to family portraits, capture your precious moments with an experienced team.

Wisuda.label: Graduation
Wisuda.title: Congratulations, you finally graduated!
Wisuda.text: Your graduation is proof of all the hard work you have put in over the past few years. Celebrate with your family, friends, and loved ones. Yogzan will help capture every moment of your graduation day so you can remember it forever.

Pernikahan.label: Wedding
Pernikahan.title: From Promises to a Lasting Story
Pernikahan.text: A wedding day is a sacred moment that unites two hearts and two families. From the emotional glances to the joyful laughter, Yogzan is ready to capture every detail with warmth and meaning. Let your love story be beautifully preserved for a lifetime.

Cetak Album.text: Transform your photos into a stunning album that you can cherish forever. Our album printing service offers high-quality materials and designs to make your memories last.

whyUs.title: Entrust Every Moment to Us
whyUs.desc: Your milestones deserve more than just photos. They deserve to be remembered beautifully. At Yogzan, we treat your moments as our own, capturing them with passion and precision. Discover six reasons why we are your perfect choice.

testimonials.title: What They Say
testimonials.desc: Each of them is special, and so are you!

chooseUs.title: Signature Editing
chooseUs.desc: More than just applying a filter. We fine-tune every color in detail to create a final result that is both aesthetic and uniquely Yogzan.

chooseUs.title: Wide Coverage
chooseUs.desc: You can find Yogzan’s services in Indonesia, Malaysia and Singapore.

chooseUs.title: Experienced Team
chooseUs.desc: Through a careful selection process, our team is composed of highly experienced professionals who are the best in their field.

chooseUs.title: Complete Packages
chooseUs.desc: From photos only to a full package with an album and video. Everything is integrated into one convenient service.

chooseUs.title: Trusted
chooseUs.desc: Since 2017, tens of thousands of clients from hundreds have trusted Yogzan to capture their most important moments.

chooseUs.title: Pose Guidance
chooseUs.desc: Feeling awkward in front of the camera? We will guide you to bring out your best look.

footer.ctaTitle: Moments May Pass, But Their Stories Last Forever
footer.ctaDesc: Click "Get Price List" and let Yogzan help capture every second into an unforgettable story.

career.mainTitle: Expand Your Photography Career with Yogzan
career.mainDesc: Already a skilled photographer and want to work on exciting projects while earning more? Join Yogzan and be part of our professional team.
career.workflowDesc: Fill out the available form to register as a Yogzan collaborator.

workflow.title: Receive Project
workflow.desc: Our team will contact you with detailed information about the project you will be working on.

workflow.title: Shoot and Send
workflow.desc: After completing the photo or video session, send all the results to Yogzan via Yogzan’s cloud storage access.

workflow.title: Receive Commission
workflow.desc: Once we have received the photos, please wait to receive your commission within 1 to 2 days.

career.joinDesc: We can’t wait to get to know you. Fill out the form below!

chooseUs.title: Flexible Schedule
chooseUs.desc: Have another job? No problem. You can work on each project whenever you are ready.

chooseUs.title: Clients Everywhere
chooseUs.desc: Yogzan has many clients spread across major cities in Indonesia, Malaysia & Singapore. Take on projects wherever you are.

chooseUs.title: Shoot. Send. Earn.
chooseUs.desc: You simply execute the shoot on site, send the results, and receive your commission. We will take care of the rest.

chooseUs.title: Develop Your Skills
chooseUs.desc: With the many projects at Yogzan, you will gain valuable experience to produce your best work. You will also receive exclusive training from Yogzan to further enhance your skills.
